insights.summary: Signal AI spam detection flags legitimate after-hours or weekend callers as spam, removing real customers from reporting.
insights.quote: It's the spam flags. Twice last month we had people call on a Sunday afternoon about a wasp nest, real customers, and Signal AI tagged them as spam. So they never showed up in the campaign reporting.

insights.summary: Front-line teams say AI call summaries save time on callbacks, dispatch and handoffs.
insights.quote: So when someone's out or a callback gets handed to dispatch, they read the AI summary instead of listening to the whole recording. A couple of the newer folks said it's how they actually learned what a good call sounds like.
